summary: Treat Highland Park Cask Strength No. 5 as one complete 2024 Bottle. Under the naming rule, `Cask Strength No. 5` is the Bottle name, so the release number stays in the name rather than the edition.

provenance.notes: Highland Park markets Cask Strength Release No. 5 as the exact expression at 64.7% ABV. Contemporary release coverage dates its launch to 2024; the broad Peated row lacks the release-specific identity. The 2026-10-23 naming rule (docs/features/bottle-presentation.md) puts `Cask Strength No. 5` in the name; the producer titles it Cask Strength Release No. 5, so both name forms are accepted (M11).

expectedBottleNames: Highland Park Cask Strength Release No. 5
